listings.title: Porsche 996 40th Anniversary manual
listings.evidence: Original advert gives £29,500, April 2004 registration, approximately 68,400 miles, UK location and Anniversary number 1132. All three thread pages checked; seller explicitly reconfirmed for sale on 30 August 2026 on page 3. No subsequent sold/deposit notice at this check.
listings.photoEvidence: Original seller front, rear and cabin photographs viewed on the first thread page. Manual gear lever visible; no sold/reserved overlays observed.
listings.notes: Advertised Anniversary number 1132 with X51 power kit, limited-slip differential and M030 suspension; verify build specification. Seller reports Michelin PS4S tyres fitted in June and a new 12-month MOT in July 2026. Mileage rises with occasional use. Seller last explicitly confirmed availability 30 August. Forum replies cite historical brake-pipe corrosion advisories; repair evidence has not been established, despite the seller reporting a fresh MOT.
listings.gavinSays: The 40th Anniversary catches my eye for its advertised X51 power kit, limited-slip differential and M030 suspension, and this one has been with its seller since 2007. I like that long ownership, but the forum raises historical brake-pipe corrosion advisories. I would want evidence those were addressed, alongside the engine history and numbered-edition paperwork; a fresh MOT alone would not settle that question.
